title: 第一卷 第23章 登门访前程第一卷 第24章 武技进阶
slug: 武道长生从猎户开始刷熟练度修行
lines: 王猎户家就在南头老槐树下，三间土坯房，院子比他家宽敞些，檐下挂着几张鞣制的毛皮。
王铁牛正蹲守着药罐，见秦猛走来，眼睛一亮：“猛子哥！”
“铁牛，你爷呢？”
秦猛大步走近。
“屋里头……又咳得厉害。”
王铁牛神色黯了黯。
“我找你爷，讨张弓。”
秦猛说着，掀开挡风的草帘进屋。
屋里光线昏暗，充斥着木材、胶漆和一种淡淡的铁锈味。
一个身形佝偻、满脸深刻皱纹的老者，正就着窗棂光亮，用粗糙的手指打磨着一段柘木弓身。
这便是王老猎户，王敢。
年轻时是边军悍卒，据说是个厉害的武者，伤退后靠制弓、打猎维生，与原身父亲关系不错，如今老迈，与孙子相依为命，家境窘迫。
“老爷子，身子要紧，该歇就歇会。”
秦猛快步上前。
王敢抬头，浑浊的老眼在秦猛脸上停留片刻，又落在他背负的斩马刀上，声音沙哑如破风箱。
“秦家小子？听说你前几日摔得不轻，看来是好了。
你这孩子，给铁牛买衣裳，花那冤枉钱作甚？”
“打猎不少挣，钱就是用来花的。”
秦猛感激地说道：“这些年，多亏王叔你们帮衬我家里呀。”
“你来是想要弓？”
王老头咳嗽着说。
秦猛点头：“猎弓断了，我想要买一张好的强弓。”
“铁牛回来说了，给你准备好了。”
王敢手撑着膝盖，颤巍巍起身，从墙上取下一张弓。
弓身呈流线型，深褐色，油光发亮，两端镶着牛角。
“此弓是铁木弓身，弦是多根牛筋麻绳绞成，二石五力，威力不输军中制式强弓，你试试。”
秦猛接过弓，入手沉实冰凉，他左脚微微前踏侧身站稳，右手勾弦左臂平举，缓缓开弓。
只听“嘎吱”
声响，弓身轻松弯如满月。
他从桌案上抽了几支箭矢，走到门口，弯弓搭箭。
箭矢化作一道黑影，瞬间钉入墙角的箭靶靶心，尾羽剧烈颤动。
秦猛再次抽箭、搭弦、开弓，动作骤然加快。
第二箭、第三箭追尾而至，皆中红心。
紧接着，他手如穿花，箭似连珠。
一支支箭矢被快速射空，箭箭钉入靶心，破空声连绵不绝。
面板上，武技“连珠箭”
的熟练度也到了500500。
几行小字浮现眼前：
【特效：目稳臂沉（大幅）】
content_en:
Wang Orion's home is located under the old locust tree in Nantou. It has three adobe houses. The yard is wider than his home, and there are several tanned furs hanging under the eaves.
Wang Tieniu was squatting guarding the medicine jar. When he saw Qin Meng approaching, his eyes lit up: "Brother Mengzi!"
"Tieniu, where is your father?"
Qin Meng strode closer.
"Inside the house... I'm coughing badly again."
Wang Tieniu's expression darkened.
"I'm looking for your master to ask for a bow."
Qin Meng said, opening the wind-proof straw curtain and entering the house.
The room was dimly lit, filled with wood, glue paint and a faint smell of rust.
An old man with a stooped body and deep wrinkles on his face was polishing a section of the eucalyptus bow with his rough fingers in the light of the window lattice.
This is Wang Lao Orion, Wang Gan.
When he was young, he was a fierce soldier in the frontier army. He was said to be a powerful warrior. After being injured, he made a living by making bows and hunting. He had a good relationship with his original father. Now he is old, dependent on his grandson, and his family is in a difficult situation.
"Old man, your health is very important. Take a rest when you need to."
Qin Meng stepped forward quickly.
Wang dared to raise his head, his turbid old eyes rested on Qin Meng's face for a moment, and then fell on the sword that he carried on his back. His voice was as hoarse as a broken bellows.
"Boy from the Qin family? I heard that you had a bad fall a few days ago. It seems that you are recovering.
You kid, why are you spending that wasted money to buy clothes for Tieniu? "
"You earn a lot from hunting, and the money is meant to be spent."
Qin Meng said gratefully: "Thanks to Uncle Wang for taking care of my family these years."
"You came here wanting a bow?"
Old Man Wang coughed and said.
Qin Meng nodded: "The hunting bow is broken. I want to buy a good strong bow."
"Tie Niu came back and said it's ready for you."
Wang Gan put his hands on his knees, stood up shakily, and took down a bow from the wall.
The bow is streamlined, dark brown and shiny, with horns on both ends.
"This bow has an ironwood bow body, and the strings are made of multiple beef tendon and hemp ropes. It has two stones and five strengths. Its power is not inferior to the strong bows in the military. Try it."
Qin Meng took the bow with a heavy and cold hand. He stepped slightly forward with his left foot and stood sideways. He hooked the string with his right hand and raised his left arm flat, and slowly opened the bow.
Just listen to "crunch"
The sound made the bow bend as easily as the full moon.
He drew a few arrows from the table, walked to the door, and bent his bow to nock an arrow.
"Boom-whoosh!"
The arrow turned into a black shadow and instantly hit the bull's-eye of the arrow target in the corner, its tail feathers trembling violently.
Qin Meng drew his arrow, set the string, and fired his bow again, his movements suddenly speeding up.
The second arrow and the third arrow came after him, both hitting the red heart.
Immediately afterwards, his hands were like piercing flowers, and his arrows were like strings of beads.
One arrow after another was shot into the air quickly, and the arrows penetrated the bull's-eye, making a continuous sound of breaking through the air.
On the panel, the martial skill "Lianzhu Arrow"
The proficiency level has also reached 500500.
A few lines of small words appeared before my eyes:
[Serial Shooting-Xiao Cheng (11000)]
[Special effects: Eyes steady and arms heavy (large)]
